name: ml_predictions
description: THE baton between Role 1 and Role 4 on Day 1. Written by Stage01_ML/03_ml_engineer.py to Stage01_ML/predictions/ml_predictions.csv. One row per (record, model). Include the baseline models too (rule, logistic) so Evaluation can compare without asking.

columns.name: y_pred
columns.note: Argmax of the probabilities. Evaluation applies cost-based thresholds on top.

columns.name: risk_score
columns.note: Single 0-1 number for ranking; normally p_critical + 0.5 * p_at_risk.

columns.name: anomaly_score
columns.note: Higher = more anomalous (Isolation Forest / One-Class SVM).
